description: Which Japanese corporations were newly registered as qualified invoice issuers, had their published details changed, or had their registration cancelled or expired, in NTA's daily difference files since a date? From this service's own record of the files it read (NTA keeps them 40 business days). Each change has the file date, observed_at, the event type and the dates as published. Corporations only. Free window: last 30 days; page with next_cursor.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous answer, to read the next page

event_type.description: Optional filter: registered, details_changed, expired, cancelled, record_deleted or past_record

since.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time with time zone, e.g. 2026-10-01; changes in difference files created on or after that date

name: invoice_registration_changes

changes.description: Corporate rows of the NTA difference files read by this service, oldest first.

file_date.description: Creation date of the NTA difference file.

observed_at.description: When this service read the file.

corporate_number.description: The 13 digits for a corporation (combine with jp-entity-evidence or jp-gbizinfo).

registration_number.description: T followed by 13 digits, as published.

history_window.description: Free history window applied to this answer.

clamped.description: true when requested_since was earlier than the free window and the answer covers only the window.

free_days.description: Days of recorded history served free of charge.

older_history.description: Status of recorded history older than the free window.

requested_since.description: The since you asked for (normalized to ISO 8601).

served_since.description: The since actually applied: requested_since, or the start of the free window if requested_since was earlier.

nta_notice.description: Always pass on: cancellation and expiry are published facts with the dates as published, not an assessment of the business.

official_check.description: Read first: as published by NTA; check the official site listed here before relying on this answer.

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.

tracking_since.description: Date of the first NTA difference file this service read. Nothing before it was observed.

title: Qualified invoice issuer changes (corporations)
